page: Microsoft Azure M416-208s_v2 is a memory-optimized enterprise instance deployed on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. The system is driven by dedicated x86_64 Intel Xeon 8280L processors running at a base clock of 2.7 GHz across 104 physical cores and 208 vCPUs. It features 32 KB L1 data cache, 1.0 MB L2 cache, and 38 MB L3 cache per socket, with hardware support for AVX, AVX-512, and AVX-512 VNNI vector instruction sets. Memory provisioning is the defining hardware attribute, delivering 5700 GB of total system RAM, which yields 27.4 GB per core. For transient and caching needs, the configuration includes 8796 GB of bundled local SSD storage. Hardware GPU acceleration is not present on this host.

Benchmark evaluations reflect the architectural trade-offs inherent in a dense, multi-socket platform. Single-threaded metrics, including a Geekbench single-core score of 1156 and single-threaded gzip compression at 22.7 GB/sec, fall into the lower quartile of current cloud processors. However, massive parallelism drives the instance into top-tier performance for aggregated throughput, marked by a multi-core stress-ng rating of 187922.32 and a PassMark CPU score of 86616.03. Memory bandwidth throughput reaches 651.24 GB/sec for uncached large reads and 10446.46 GB/sec for small cached reads, powering extreme in-memory metrics such as 162.62 million Redis SET operations per second.

From an operational cost-efficiency perspective, the M416-208s_v2 represents a high-density capital footprint designed specifically to avoid distributed clustering overhead. Instead of scaling out across dozens of smaller compute nodes, it consolidates massive memory footprints onto a single host. Ideal workloads include massive in-memory databases such as SAP HANA, multi-terabyte Redis deployments, large-scale enterprise data warehousing, and heavy parallel compilation suites.
description: Microsoft Azure M416-208s_v2 is an enterprise-grade memory-optimized virtual machine powered by 104 dedicated physical cores (208 vCPUs) of Intel Xeon 8280L processors clocked at 2.7 GHz. The system provides 5700 GB of system memory, averaging 27.4 GB per core, and includes 8796 GB of integrated local SSD storage without discrete GPUs. While single-thread execution speeds are modest due to moderate clock frequencies, the platform excels in highly concurrent multi-threaded computation, registering top-tier stress-ng multi-core and PassMark execution scores. Its high-throughput memory subsystem delivers uncached reads exceeding 651 GB/sec, driving exceptional performance in in-memory key-value processing, such as over 162 million Redis SET operations per second. This instance is architecturally engineered for massive in-memory databases like SAP HANA, extensive data warehousing, and consolidated enterprise-scale analytics.
